whole_queries.__baseline_prompt__: Make a natural photographic portrait of campus daily life, centered on the reference woman in an ordinary moment. Use the supplied photograph as a face-and-hair appearance reference: retain her softly rounded oval jawline, large brown eyes, small straight nose, softly full pink lips, and chin-length dark bob with a wispy parted fringe. At a university cafeteria table she slides a closed notebook into an open canvas tote, her right hand guiding the notebook's top edge while her left hand holds the tote mouth apart. The tote rests on the tabletop to her left, its base visibly supported; the notebook enters the opening at a shallow diagonal with both hands and the opening unobstructed. Her torso turns slightly toward the bag as she lifts her gaze toward the camera, leaving the face easy to compare with the reference. An oatmeal knit cardigan falls loosely over a pale blue T-shirt, giving the portrait quiet tactile softness. A cleared meal tray at the far edge of the table and receding cafeteria tables establish a brief pause before she leaves. In a waist-up three-quarter view at seated eye level, keep her face the main point of attention and the notebook-packing contact the second. Soft window light models her face and hands, with natural skin texture, gentle falloff and restrained warm color. The photograph should feel observed during an everyday transition, with the tabletop and surrounding campus space still legible.

An observational photograph of the reference subject in campus daily life, caught in an ordinary moment between activities beside a university academic building. Preserve the supplied reference's visible facial proportions, dark brown eyes, soft oval face, small straight nose, natural pink lips and fair skin, together with the dark jaw-length bob and fine wispy bangs. The subject stands beside a stationary city bicycle, wearing a soft grey short-sleeved shirt and straight dark trousers. A slim notebook is halfway inside its front wire basket: the subject's right fingertips still hold the notebook's upper edge, while the left hand rests around the near handlebar grip. The notebook's lower edge is already supported by the basket floor; its front cover tilts toward the camera so the hand, cover and basket rim read separately. The subject looks down at this small task, lips relaxed, hair falling naturally toward one cheek. The bicycle rests upright on its kickstand on level paving; the body is turned three quarters toward the camera with weight settled through both feet. A brick wall, shaded building entrance and a few distant bicycles give the place an inhabited university rhythm. Soft late-afternoon daylight brushes the cheek and picks out individual strands of hair, with reflected brightness from the paving. Frame from just above the head to the upper thighs, keeping both hands and the whole basket in the lower half, at an easy conversational distance. Use a natural perspective and moderate depth of field so the face, working fingers and notebook remain clear while the entrance recedes gently. The image feels like a brief pause before departure, with attention held by the person's particular presence and the simple physical completion of packing.
